name: pr-review
description: On a pull request, run staticcheck (lint), gosec (SAST), govulncheck (SCA) and Trivy (container: Dockerfile misconfig, dependency CVEs, leaked secrets — in its own sandbox), post their results as markdown-table PR comments, then run a code review and a security review whose findings (issues, vulns, and recommendations) are posted as further PR comments. Trigger with inputs {repo, number, ref, sha}: repo is the git-factory repo NAME under ops/, number the PR number, ref the PR source branch, sha its head commit. The reviewers read the tree at the PR head plus the scan/ reports and write a markdown findings table which a Go poster (embedded, go-run in the scan image) posts via git-factory's PR comments API.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: git-factory repo name within the namespace

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}" 2>/dev/null || git checkout -q "${inputs.sha}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo cloned; git log --oneline -1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan; (go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./... > scan/lint.txt 2>&1 || true); (go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -quiet -fmt=json -out=scan/sast.json ./... 2>/dev/null || true); (go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./... > scan/sca.txt 2>&1 || true); echo scan-done; ls -la scan

export TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/trivy-cache; mkdir -p /workspace/scan /tmp/trivy-cache; cd /workspace; trivy fs --scanners vuln,misconfig,secret --no-progress --format table --output scan/container.txt . 2>/tmp/trivy.log || { echo 'trivy did not complete (log tail):' > scan/container.txt; tail -8 /tmp/trivy.log >> scan/container.txt; }; echo container-scan-done; ls -la scan; echo '--- container.txt (head) ---'; head -40 scan/container.txt

with.task: Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for quality.
Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for security.

with.run:
set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod /tmp/ext; export GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/ext/main.go; cd /tmp/ext && printf 'module ext

go 1.25
' > go.mod; tasks=$(go run . /workspace/review-security.md /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/findings.json); export tasks; echo "tasks=$tasks"

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; mkdir -p /workspace/.preserve; cp -f review-quality.md review-security.md /workspace/.preserve/ 2>/dev/null || true; git fetch -q "$GIT_URL" "${inputs.ref}"; git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; cp -f /workspace/.preserve/review-quality.md /workspace/.preserve/review-security.md /workspace/ 2>/dev/null || true; echo "refreshed to $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; export PR_COMMENT_AUTHOR=f8406f21-36b7-4398-b898-a76b36899ac0; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); [ -n "$RID" ] || { echo 'could not resolve repo id'; exit 1; }; mkdir -p /workspace/.prreview/out; echo '' | base64 -d > /workspace/.prreview/poster.go; printf '%s' '${steps.fix.output}' > /workspace/.prreview/outcomes.json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]' > /workspace/.prreview/outcomes.json; [ -s /workspace/findings.json ] || echo '[]' > /workspace/findings.json; go run /workspace/.prreview/poster.go /workspace/scan /workspace/.prreview/out /workspace/findings.json /workspace/.prreview/outcomes.json /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/review-security.md; fail=0; for f in /workspace/.prreview/out/comment-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --max-time 60 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/${inputs.number}/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @"$f" || echo 000); echo "posted $f -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) fail=1;; esac; done; [ "$fail" = 0 ] || echo 'warning: one or more comments failed to post (non-fatal; review verdict + gate still proceed)'; echo report-done

with.task: Summarise pull request #${inputs.number} and give a merge recommendation.

with.run:
set +e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; export PR_COMMENT_AUTHOR=f8406f21-36b7-4398-b898-a76b36899ac0; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; NUM='${inputs.number}'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '

' "$VER";   [ -f SUMMARY.md ] && { cat SUMMARY.md; printf '

'; };   printf '## Changelog

%s

' "$FEATS";   [ -n "$FIXES" ] && printf '### Fixes
%s

' "$FIXES";   [ -n "$OTHER" ] && printf '### Other
%s
' "$OTHER"; } > /tmp/rel.md; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/main.go; mkdir -p /tmp/jw && mv /tmp/main.go /tmp/jw/ && cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod && go run . /tmp/rel.md > /tmp/rel.json; cd /workspace; [ -n "$RID" ] && [ -n "$NUM" ] && { code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --max-time 60 --retry 3 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/rel.json || echo 000); echo "release comment ($VER) -> $code"; } || echo 'no RID/NUM -- skipping release comment'; exit 0

steps.name: gate
steps.description: Deterministic auto-merge: merge to dev only on a clean pr-summary MERGE verdict; nudges/hold stay for a human. Non-fatal.

with.run:
set +e
export HOME=/tmp
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
cd /workspace
NUM='${inputs.number}'; REPO='${inputs.repo}'
TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#')
GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002
i=0; while [ "$(timeout 12 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$GF/healthz" 2>/dev/null)" = "000" ]; do i=$((i+1)); [ "$i" -ge 10 ] && { echo "gate: git-factory unreachable, leaving PR for a human"; exit 0; }; sleep 5; done
if [ ! -f SUMMARY.md ]; then echo "gate: no SUMMARY.md — leaving PR #$NUM for a human"; exit 0; fi
VERDICT=$(sed -n '/## Recommendation/,$p' SUMMARY.md | sed '1d' | grep -m1 -oE 'MERGE WITH NUDGES|MERGE|HOLD')
echo "gate: pr-summary verdict = ${VERDICT:-unknown}"
if [ "$VERDICT" != "MERGE" ]; then echo "gate: holding PR #$NUM for a human (verdict ${VERDICT:-unknown})"; exit 0; fi
RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1)
[ -n "$RID" ] || { echo "gate: could not resolve repo id, leaving PR #$NUM"; exit 0; }
CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/m -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 30 --retry 3 -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/merge" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"auto-merge: clean pr-review (MERGE)"}')
case "$CODE" in 200|201|204) echo "gate: auto-merged PR #$NUM to dev (verdict MERGE)";; *) echo "gate: merge of PR #$NUM failed HTTP $CODE (left for a human):"; cat /tmp/m;; esac
exit 0
